QuestInfo.name: [Tallahart] A Voice from on High
QuestInfo.0: Gob suddenly appears through dimensional gate to help out. Hear what he has to say.
QuestInfo.1: Gob says a powerful ancient god is trying to gather the remaining ancient gods together. You need to tell the Alliance about this.
QuestInfo.2: If Gob's info is true, there will be a huge war in the near future. Why do the ancient gods oppose Gerand Darmoor the way they do?
